messages:
Jae Park: Hey people-ops — quick question. I got married in Ireland last month (2026-06-15) and want to add my partner to medical + dental. They don't have an SSN. What docs are acceptable and how do I upload them? Also: can coverage be retro to the marriage date?
Samira Khan: Congrats Jae!! :tada: Short answers: yes you can add them as a QLE (marriage), and coverage can be retro to the event date if approved. Docs we typically need for an international partner without SSN: passport, marriage certificate (original or certified copy), and one of the following: foreign tax ID (if available), national ID card, OR a notarized affidavit explaining lack of SSN. If marriage cert is not in English, we need a certified translation.
Samira Khan: Upload steps: 1) Go to https://hr.redwood.com/secure-upload 2) Choose "Dependent Addition (QLE)" 3) Attach original docs + translation (if any) 4) In notes put your marriage date and partner name. Or if you'd rather, email the same files via the secure link we provide to hr@redwood.com (do not send attachments over regular email).
Samira Khan: Timing: QLE window = 30 days from event date to submit. Because your marriage was 2026-06-15, the standard window would be until 2026-07-15. If you missed that window we can evaluate extenuating circumstances (e.g., inability to get certified copies quickly) but that's handled case-by-case.
Jae Park: Thanks — I should be able to upload today. Do translations need to be notarized/certified by a translator?
Samira Khan: Certified translations preferred (translator statement + translator signature). Notarization of the translation is fine but not strictly required if the translator statement is clear. If you want us to accept a non-certified translation temporarily, we can, but final approval will require the certified one.
Liam O'Connor: FYI on payroll/tax: enrollment can proceed without SSN, but for US payroll reporting you'll need an ITIN or SSN eventually. If they get an ITIN later, please upload it to the same secure portal so we can update payroll records.
People Ops Bot: Reminder: QLE uploads should include the event date and supporting docs. Secure upload link: https://hr.redwood.com/secure-upload — do not attach PII in public channels.
Jae Park: Uploaded just now as "1765432100_jae_marriage.zip" via the secure portal; included passport + marriage cert (original Irish) + rough English translation (not certified). I also sent a note to hr@redwood.com via secure link.
Samira Khan: Got the upload, thanks. I'll run an initial check and send to BenefitsAdmin for processing. Expect an approval/update within 2 business days. If we need the certified translation we'll ask you to supply it, but we'll start processing with what you uploaded so we don't lose the retro coverage possibility.
BenefitsAdmin: Processing the submission now. Quick note: dental enrollment requires the dependent enrollment form (e-sign). We'll send you a DocuSign for that after approval.
Jae Park: Awesome — appreciate the fast help. Will watch for the DocuSign. :pray:
Samira Khan: No problem — ping me if anything blocks the certified translation or ITIN timeline. Happy marriage again! :confetti_ball:
